A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the card-type or stat bar, the game-text box and the numbers beside it) with the corrected game text and a white E in the black lower border, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its Decipher Errata sheet dated 1 March 2017.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-D-imperialgunner-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Imperial Gunner (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]] (by 5 June 2016): Same words as the 2013 slip. This is a slip again: the lower part of the card with the white italic “E” in the black lower border; unlike the 2013 slip it prints no title.

The disc card (lower part, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2017 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
